message: Blog → personal site: added notes + projects collections, /now /projects /writing /notes routes, cut nav to 5 items, /blog redirects to /writing. Chose not to nest posts under /writing so no existing post URL changes.

Phase 5: deleted Card/Badge/BlogCard for row-based lists, unified hero taglines into PageHero, fixed two Tailwind v4 cascade-layer bugs (unlayered element rules beating utilities; typography plugin's light-mode --tw-prose-* vars), shiki now dual-theme on data-theme.
